categories.main_business_segments: Beijing UBOX Online Technology Corp. operates primarily in four segments: unmanned retail business, merchandise wholesale, advertising and system support services, and others including mobile device distribution, vending machine sales and leases, and karaoke booths. The unmanned retail business involves sales of fast-moving consumer goods through a network of vending machines. Merchandise wholesale serves vending machine operators and other customers. Advertising and system support services include merchandise display advertising and operation system fees.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data analytics, Internet of Things (IoT), biometric authentication, and smart vending machine hardware design. Their vending machines incorporate AI-powered recognition, intelligent inventory management, and energy-saving systems. Software development and digital operation systems underpin their data-driven sales estimation, personalized marketing, and operational efficiency. All vending machines are custom-made by the Group from factories, while merchandise is sourced from suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include end consumers purchasing fast-moving consumer goods via vending machines, vending machine operators who buy merchandise wholesale, advertisers using the digital advertising platform, and partners operating Non-Ubox POSs. The company also serves mobile device resellers through its mobile device distribution services. Key consumption scenarios include schools, factories, office premises, public venues, transportation hubs, restaurants, and communities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates predominantly in mainland China, with a focus on tier one, new tier one, tier two, and tier three cities, as well as expanding into lower-tier cities. It has a presence in over 262 cities across mainland China. The company also maintains offices and principal places of business in Beijing, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing UBOX Online Technology Corp. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manages vending machine operations (retail) and merchandise wholesale, acting as both operator and distributor. The company does not engage in product manufacturing but procures merchandise from suppliers and manages logistics, inventory, and retail operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation focusing on AI, big data, IoT, and digital operations to enhance vending machine intelligence, sales estimation, inventory management, and customer experience. It invests in upgrading vending machine hardware and software, developing proprietary products, and expanding digital advertising capabilities. Strategic plans include expanding POS network coverage, diversifying merchandise and services, exploring new business models like community retail and online-offline integration, and strengthening collaborations with commercial real estate and community organizations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through sales of fast-moving consumer goods via unmanned retail vending machines, wholesale merchandise sales to vending machine operators, fees from advertising and system support services, and sales or leasing of vending machines and other services such as mobile device distribution and karaoke booth operations. The company also earns revenue from digital advertising services and operation system fees charged to Non-Ubox POS operators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading vending machine operator in mainland China with a strong technological and digital operation advantage. It competes in the unmanned retail industry, focusing on expanding its POS network and enhancing operational efficiency. Specific competitors are not named in the report, but the company faces intense industry competition and rising POS acquisition costs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 2.92 billion, a 9.2% increase year-on-year. Gross profit was RMB 1.04 billion with a 4.4% decrease year-on-year. The company recorded a net loss attributable to owners of RMB 197.3 million, improving by 39.7% compared to the previous year. The number of Ubox POSs increased by 12.4% to 67,144 units. The company’s gearing ratio was 16.1%, with total equity of RMB 805.9 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology-driven smart retail solutions offering convenient, anytime-anywhere shopping experiences through a vast and optimized network of intelligent vending machines. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced AI and IoT-enabled vending machines, data-driven operations for precise inventory and marketing management, diversified and customized merchandise offerings, and integrated digital advertising services. The company also provides comprehensive unmanned retail solutions to partners, enhancing operational efficiency and profitability.
